```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'MOT-925-BLK-02620'
),
containing_components(component_id) AS (
    -- the component itself (models may reference it directly)
    SELECT component_id FROM target
    UNION
    -- walk upward: assemblies that contain it directly or via nested sub-assemblies
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id
    FROM containing_components cc
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.child_component_id = cc.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)

FROM model_bom mb

  AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to);
```

```sql
    -- start at the target component
    SELECT 'component', 'MOT-925-BLK-02620'
    UNION
    -- walk upward: who uses this node (components or models) under the current BOM
    SELECT c.parent_kind, c.parent_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN up u

      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.model_code) AS model_count
FROM up
JOIN company_model m
  ON m.model_code = up.code
WHERE up.kind = 'model';
```

```sql
WITH sold_lines AS (
    SELECT ol.listing_id, ol.qty AS line_qty
    FROM order_line ol
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
    JOIN store s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND s.country = 'UK'
      AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND o.order_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
model_units AS (
    -- Non-bundle SKUs map directly to models
    SELECT m.model_id, sl.line_qty * sm.qty AS units
    FROM sold_lines sl
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = sl.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE NOT sk.is_bundle
    UNION ALL
    -- Bundle SKUs: expand through bundle items, which map to models
    SELECT m.model_id, sl.line_qty * bi.qty * sm.qty AS units
    FROM sold_lines sl
    JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = sl.listing_id
    JOIN sales_sku sk ON sk.sku_id = l.sku_id
    JOIN bundle_item bi ON bi.bundle_sku_id = sk.sku_id
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_id = bi.item_sku_id
    JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = sm.model_id
    WHERE sk.is_bundle
)
SELECT m.model_code
FROM model_units mu
JOIN company_model m ON m.model_id = mu.model_id
GROUP BY m.model_id, m.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(mu.units) DESC, m.model_code
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE sku_model AS (
    -- base: non-bundle SKU -> company model (current BOM as of 2026-10-01)
    SELECT c.parent_code AS sku_code,
           c.child_code AS model_code,
           c.qty AS mult
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_code = c.parent_code AND s.is_bundle = FALSE
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'model'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- walk up: a bundle containing a mapped SKU inherits its model mappings x qty
    SELECT c.parent_code,
           sm.model_code,
           sm.mult * c.qty
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_code = c.child_code
    WHERE c.parent_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.child_kind = 'sku'
      AND c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= c.valid_to)
)
SELECT m.model_code
FROM order_line ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN listing l ON l.listing_id = ol.listing_id
JOIN store st ON st.store_id = l.store_id
JOIN sales_sku s ON s.sku_id = l.sku_id
JOIN sku_model sm ON sm.sku_code = s.sku_code
JOIN company_model m ON m.model_code = sm.model_code
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_date >= DATE '2024-01-01'
  AND o.order_date <= DATE '2024-12-31'
  AND st.country = 'UK'
GROUP BY m.model_code
ORDER BY SUM(ol.qty * sm.mult) DESC
LIMIT 3;
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'TE2-160WHT47-0726'
),
bom_expansion AS (
    -- Direct components of the model (current BOM as of 2026-10-01)
    SELECT mb.component_id,
           c.is_assembly
    FROM model_bom mb
    JOIN target_model tm ON tm.model_id = mb.model_id
    JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
    WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recurse into assembly components (current component BOM edges)
    SELECT cb.child_component_id,
           c2.is_assembly
    FROM bom_expansion be
    JOIN component_bom cb ON cb.parent_component_id = be.component_id
    JOIN component c2 ON c2.component_id = cb.child_component_id
    WHERE be.is_assembly = TRUE
      AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT component_id) AS distinct_part_count
FROM bom_expansion
WHERE is_assembly = FALSE;
```

```sql
  FROM bundle_item bi
```
```sql
  JOIN bundle b ON bi.bundle_sku_id = b.sku_id
),

  FROM items i
```

```sql
  FROM models m
  JOIN model_bom mb
    ON mb.model_id = m.model_id

  JOIN component c ON c.component_id = mb.component_id
),

  SELECT cb.child_component_id, t.qty * cb.qty, c.is_assembly
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE
target_model AS (
    SELECT model_id
    FROM company_model
    WHERE model_code = 'CO9-180WHT64-0743'
),
target_part AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'CRO-707-GRY-02584'
      AND is_assembly = FALSE
),
expand(model_id, component_id, path_qty) AS (
    -- Top-level components of the model, valid on 2025-10-25
    SELECT mb.model_id,
           mb.component_id,
           mb.qty
    FROM model_bom mb
    WHERE mb.model_id = (SELECT model_id FROM target_model)
      AND mb.valid_from <= DATE '2025-10-25'
      AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-10-25' <= mb.valid_to)
    UNION ALL
    -- Recurse into sub-assemblies, multiplying quantities along each path
    SELECT e.model_id,
           cb.child_component_id,
           e.path_qty * cb.qty
    FROM expand e
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.parent_component_id = e.component_id
    WHERE cb.valid_from <= DATE '2025-10-25'
      AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-10-25' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(e.path_qty), 0) AS units_required
FROM expand e
WHERE e.component_id = (SELECT component_id FROM target_part);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE paths(node_kind, node_code, mult) AS (
    SELECT 'model'::VARCHAR AS node_kind,
           'CO9-180WHT64-0743'::VARCHAR AS node_code,
           1::DOUBLE AS mult
    UNION ALL
    SELECT e.child_kind,
           e.child_code,
           p.mult * e.qty
    FROM paths p
    JOIN u_composition e
      ON e.parent_kind = p.node_kind
     AND e.parent_code = p.node_code
     AND e.child_kind = 'component'
    WHERE DATE '2025-10-25' >= e.valid_from
      AND (e.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2025-10-25' <= e.valid_to)
)
SELECT SUM(mult) AS units_required
FROM paths
WHERE node_kind = 'component'
  AND node_code = 'CRO-707-GRY-02584';
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE target AS (
    SELECT component_id
    FROM component
    WHERE component_code = 'ASM-123-03577'
),
containing AS (
    -- the component itself, plus every assembly that contains it (recursively)
    SELECT component_id FROM target
    UNION
    SELECT cb.parent_component_id AS component_id
    FROM containing c
    JOIN component_bom cb
      ON cb.child_component_id = c.component_id
     AND cb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
     AND (cb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= cb.valid_to)
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT mb.model_id) AS model_count
FROM model_bom mb
JOIN containing c
  ON mb.component_id = c.component_id
WHERE mb.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
  AND (mb.valid_to IS NULL OR DATE '2026-10-01' <= mb.valid_to);
```

```sql
WITH RECURSIVE up(parent_kind, parent_code) AS (
    -- Direct parents of the target component (models directly, or assembly components)
    SELECT parent_kind, parent_code
    FROM u_composition
    WHERE child_kind = 'component'
      AND child_code = 'ASM-123-03577'
      AND valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (valid_to IS NULL OR valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')

    UNION

    -- Climb further up through assembly components
    SELECT c.parent_kind, c.parent_code
    FROM u_composition c
    JOIN up u
      ON u.parent_kind = 'component'
     AND c.child_kind = 'component'
     AND c.child_code = u.parent_code
    WHERE c.valid_from <= DATE '2026-10-01'
      AND (c.valid_to IS NULL OR c.valid_to >= DATE '2026-10-01')
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT parent_code) AS model_count
FROM up
WHERE parent_kind = 'model';
```
